persona_summary: Thomas (28) is a nurse at UZ Gent. He saves €400 every month, has €18,400 in his savings account and pays the last instalment of his car loan next month.
diary_opener: Hey Thomas, I've already lived your next month. In November €310 a month suddenly freed up, and I had to choose what to do with it.

cards.title: This year my savings lost €240 in value
cards.body: My €18,400 earned 1.5%, but prices rose faster. A buffer is smart, but the part above it could have worked harder.

signals.label: Savings account
signals.detail: €18,400 at 1.5%, while prices rise about 2.8% a year

signals.label: €400 saved every month
signals.detail: For 3 years now, without skipping a single month

signals.label: Summer is your big cost
signals.detail: Last July and August about €2,900 went on holidays, and your flight to Lisbon is already booked

actions.title: Your buffer: about €8,900 is enough
actions.body: Three months of costs (about €6,000) plus your summer trip (about €2,900). The rest can go to longer-term goals, if you want.

actions.title: Talk it over with an adviser
actions.body: A 20-minute chat, after your shift too. Bring all your questions about saving and investing.

cards.title: The month after, €310 a month freed up
cards.body: At the end of October I paid the last instalment of my car loan. Without a plan, that €310 just vanished into everyday spending.

signals.label: Car loan ending
signals.detail: Instalment 47 of 48 is paid. From November €310 a month stays in your account.

signals.label: €400 saved every month
signals.detail: For 3 years now, without skipping a single month

cards.title: This month I took my first small step into investing
cards.body: I had read up, asked about the risks and opened Bolero twice. Starting small turned out to be a good way to learn.

signals.label: Articles about investing
signals.detail: You read 5 of them in the app this month

signals.label: Opened Bolero
signals.detail: You visited the Bolero home page 2 times and stopped at choosing a fund

actions.title: Invest from €50 a month
actions.body: A KBC investment plan through Bolero: €50 a month in a broad fund, which you can pause or stop at any time. You pick up where you left off.

actions.title: Investing explained in 3 minutes
actions.body: What risk really means, why time helps and what you could lose. Honest, short, no fund names.

cards.title: On 31 December I left €315 of tax benefit on the table
cards.body: Anyone who pays into pension savings before 31 December gets up to 30% back in tax. I hadn't thought of it yet.

signals.label: No pension savings yet
signals.detail: You get up to 30% back on your taxes, on at most €1,050 a year

signals.label: Savings account
signals.detail: €18,400 at 1.5%, while prices rise about 2.8% a year

actions.title: Start pension savings before 31 December
actions.body: Pay in up to €1,050 this year and get up to €315 back on your taxes. One transfer from your savings account is enough.
